notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have pushed a small update for Bathhouse Creatures. Below are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where duplicate guests can be spawned in "The New Bathhouse In Town"

Thank you! ♥️

notes.title: v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have pushed a small update for Bathhouse Creatures. Below are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed Resolution settings in the Options menu to be changed even in fullscreen mode
[*] Fixed a visual bug on the Objective Panel collapse/expand button
[*] Fixed a bug with the "Crouching Tiger, Sleeping Dragon" Steam achievement
[/list]
We hope everyone has enjoyed the game so far! Please do [b]leave a review[/b] if you haven't, as reaching 10 reviews gives a huge visibility boost on Steam, which is great for a small team like us! ♥️

Thank you!

notes.title: Bathhouse Creatures Demo - Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ✨

We have released an update for the Bathhouse Creatures Demo! This update implements some gameplay features along with UI touch ups.

[list]
[*] Room Decor is now switchable. Players will now be able to buy and switch decor freely within a room.
[*] Guest Forecast feature has been implemented. Players will now be shown an expected distribution of guests at the start of each day.
[*] Guest star ratings have been added. Each guest will now display stars above their head corresponding to their happiness with your Service.
[*] Further UI improvement for clearer feedback to the player
[*] Dialogue touch ups  
[/list]
Thank you everyone for playing! We will see you at Steam Next Fest! ❤️

Sleepy Rocket
